permutation: Within each M46 eligible domain/split/token group, sort contexts by SHA256 of compact JSON token prefix, then map each recipient to next context cyclically. No self donors; exact bijection over unique prefixes. No seed/outcome selection.
scope: All192original input sequences, all6half directions; replace missing half only at M46 eligible positions. Keep full native write at all ineligible positions. Both arms use same means/maps; downstream live.
metrics: Full-position output KL/CE/top1 and task margins, eligible local error and effect inventory. Report cohort/layer and mask direction. No success threshold or optimal strength selection.
limits: Donor states are an oracle diagnostic, potentially from later positions/other sequences; this is not a deployable predictor or new-task discovery. Unique-prefix marginal preservation does not imply occurrence-weighted marginal preservation when full sequences repeat prefixes.
stopping: One fixed permutation and paired comparison. No donor/seed/amplitude search; preserve all excluded positions and failures. Then synthesize implications for reusable units and featurizer controls.
